Sandbox_B47ANCEDKnowledgeAndWisdom_Enabl: Adds a read-only research viewer to registered documents. Normal reading still controls knowledge unlocks.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDKnowledgeAndWisdom_Seman: Scales provider-defined semantic XP on authority. 100 preserves provider rates; 0 disables semantic XP awards.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDKnowledgeAndWisdom_Repea: Scales each provider repeat window. 100 preserves its window. Active counters and uncertain awards are never evicted to make room.
Scales provider repeat decay. 100 preserves it; 0 removes the repeat penalty. Applies on the server.
Scales the provider minimum repeat credit, capped at full credit. 100 preserves the provider floor; 0 permits decay towards zero.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDKnowledgeAndWisdom_Journ: Maximum share of documented raw XP included in a server recovery plan. A provider may request less. Plans never reduce or add to existing XP. Native XP restoration remains unimplemented.
Scales server-validated writing work. 100 preserves the existing speed. This does not enable unfinished native journal timed actions.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDKnowledgeAndWisdom_Failu: Caps failure outcome credit as a percentage of provider base XP, before other bounded modifiers. Providers may award less. 0 disables failure credit.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDKnowledgeAndWisdom_Enabl: Show read-only inspection for recorded Survivor Journals. Default enabled; existing saves use this default. This does not enable writing or recovery actions.
